verdict.rationale: The GitHub Marketplace lists a Slack app described as letting you "connect your code without leaving Slack" (github-intdir-5), within a broader catalog of apps that integrate with GitHub (github-docs-22). This points to chat-tool integration, but nothing explicitly shows repository notifications or activity being synced to chat. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of notification/activity feeds to chat channels, configuration details (subscriptions, filters), support for chat tools beyond Slack (e.g. Teams), confirmation the Slack app is first-party, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
